title: apium lineare
intro: Apium lineare, commonly known as the linear hog's fennel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues and relieving respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Apium lineare involve its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
